scope: Educational 3D potential-flow pressures coupled one way to nominal spatial-beam stress for finite tips, or homogeneous closed-tip section normal stress and transverse pure bending at zero user sweep/dihedral/incidence. No local solid-FE stress, strength approval, viscous/stall model or full zero-tip motion/torsion.

features: Compact Aerodynamics and Structure & Stress input panels
Upper/lower surface Cp and pressure contours
Sectional Cp and spanwise lift curves
Coefficient, convergence and admission tables
Aerodynamic CSV and PNG exports
Rotatable 3D Cp and pressure on the actual aerodynamic panel surface
Optional visible panel boundaries in 3D and 2D
Signed blue-green-red scale with green at zero
On-screen aerodynamic mesh-stage progress and elapsed time
Independent aerodynamic results for exact zero-chord elliptic and delta tips
Full wing mirror in the View menu
Open and Save JSON in File
Two-spar course example with bonded module seams
Structural solve and result-contour activity feedback
Airfoils & planform first in the wing context menu
Full-range pressure colour contrast with linear and manual range options
Explicit hatching and counts for pressure panels outside manual colour limits
Expandable per-mesh pressure-extrema sensitivity check
LE/TE and flow markers on the 3D pressure surface
Signed sectional Cp with suction at the top
Section lift coefficient, circulation, moment and trailing-edge Cp difference graphs
Unified current-figure PNG and aerodynamic CSV commands in File
Lightweight anatomy switching and paused hidden structural rendering
Independent 2D section panel solver with selected/half-density Cp curves, cl and quarter-chord cm
2D PNG/CSV exports and clickable Cp/tangential-speed probes
Explicit amber/dashed local tip-uncertainty samples without clipping values
Step-by-step panel algorithm, equations and accuracy Help
Surface-metric gradient reconstruction across thin leading edges and closed rounded-tip seams; local sharp-tip/wake pressure remains unvalidated
Rounded-tip sectional Cp entries explicitly labelled unvalidated; section labels refresh with the current geometry
New and imported studies open as complete opaque geometry with reset camera fit and display filters
Aerodynamic result overlay closes when a study is created or imported
Closed-tip/spatial comparison state cannot abort a later classical-wing solve
Conservative six-component aerodynamic load transfer to actual zero-chord delta/elliptic section studies
Chord-weighted force and chord-squared restoring couple preserve each strip force and moment
Nominal normal stress and transverse pure bending, with exact-apex stress and torsional response withheld
Explicit provenance of extrapolated estimates, mesh uncertainty and numerical admission checks
Measured-reference error distinguished from internal consistency and target-lift trimming
Rib-to-independent-2D action with linked eta and millimetre section controls
Deformation controls hidden for aerodynamic results; actual structural visual multiplier displayed
Per-result contour field caching and reduced unchanged GPU redraws without changing numerical fields
Valid-load coupling refusal is distinct from malformed input or aerodynamic solver failure
Actionable stiffness, speed and model-limit feedback with actual twist/lift values
Current geometry preview restored after coupled structural result is withheld
Independent unit-chord 2D Cp distinguished from actual 3D wing sectional Cp; linked nearest solved strip
Section cl and whole-wing CL use explicit definitions and case labels
Second-spar guidance separates reduced twist from load admission and small-displacement validity
Readable exact-flow Cp and signed trailing-edge error figures retain every raw sample
Failed geometry construction retains the last visible model and releases only the rejected candidate
Admission refusal restores a complete opaque undeformed geometry preview with fitted camera
Live km/h equivalent beside m/s input; aerodynamic speed validity distinguished from structural coupling limits
Unloaded structures show a neutral model and an explicit zero-response notice, with direct load setup actions
Solved aerodynamic fields are clearly distinguished from loads actually applied to structural equilibrium
Constant and unresolved fields do not fabricate a unit contour range; unloaded PNGs contain no false legend or stress probes
Optional background design advisor compares stiffness and mass with actual structural solves, retains all inputs and admission, and labels exact-tip inboard trials without a full-wing optimum

three_dimensional_release_status: Qualified educational tensor-quadratic release, source 17bdcbe. Deepest tip pressure remains unvalidated; U is empirical. Original failed gates are preserved in the numerical review.
